KIT-003.definition: A kitchen mandoline made of ABS with stainless‑steel blades, offering five adjustable thickness settings and a julienne insert, plus a hand guard for safe slicing and shredding of vegetables.

KIT-025.definition: A traditional wooden hand churner (Madhani) crafted from sheesham wood, 45 cm long with a star‑shaped churn head, used for manually churning butter, curd or other dairy products.

KIT-007.definition: A stainless‑steel bench scraper featuring a 15 × 11 cm blade, wooden handle, and built‑in inch and centimetre measuring marks, ideal for smoothing dough, cutting pastry and cleaning work surfaces.

TOL-001.definition: A 4‑in‑1 electronic wall scanner that detects wood studs, metal objects, live AC wires and deep‑scan targets, with an LCD display and powered by a 9 V battery, useful for safe drilling and mounting.

ORG-005.definition: A 30 cm clear acrylic Lazy Susan turntable that rotates 360°, providing easy access to spices, condiments or small kitchen items stored on a countertop.

FUR-001.definition: A round stool made from woven cane and reed, standing 45 cm tall with a 40 cm seat diameter, ideal for casual seating in living rooms or verandas.

FUR-036.definition: A hand‑carved Sheesham‑wood rehal that folds flat (30 cm when open), used as a decorative floor cushion or low seating piece in living rooms.

KIT-053.definition: A 7 cm diameter disc of heat‑resistant glass that sits on top of a pot to prevent water or milk from boiling over, protecting stovetops and cookware.

TOL-018.definition: A 5‑metre long, 6 mm spring‑steel cable with a crank‑drum handle, designed to clear clogs in drains and pipes.

KIT-015.definition: A 12‑inch pre‑seasoned cast‑iron tawa, weighing about 2.1 kg, perfect for making flatbreads, pancakes, and stir‑frying on the stove.
